page.meta_description: Actium, off western Greece, was Agrippa's defeat of Antony and Cleopatra. Within a year the principate had a single master. Related pages: Augustus.
page.content:
31 BCE naval victory that left Octavian alone.

How Battle of Actium connects

  • Character: Augustus — Actium left Octavian free to become Augustus.

What is Battle of Actium?

Actium, off western Greece, was Agrippa's defeat of Antony and Cleopatra. Within a year the principate had a single master.
